et_control: Long-looped ET compared with cipher f188v and freshly inspected contemporary plaintext f185 (nous en serions mieux et); primary crop and source bounds included.
method: The initial pilot and later rows L05/L10 have independent class-only checks before proposed text. Most other later readings use image-first drafts followed by French-context-assisted choices and partial non-blind review. Mechanical compatibility is not a proof of uniqueness or visual certainty. A further blind class-only pass checks M8 and L14. It triggers a new M8 position37 gap. The ET sign remains independently control-grounded, not identified from the limited printed key by that pass.
ordinary_prose: Conservative opening, interspersed prose, abbreviations and closing are transcribed in the ordinary_*_spans.json files and integrated into letter_reading_FR.txt; unresolved paleography remains bracketed.

counts.meaning: Coverage counts are not accuracy rates; unknown-length edge/ink regions and ordinary abbreviations are indexing placeholders.
